title: The Magnet IS a U — Set It on ? — The Balance Point IS the Klein Point
motto: You can NEVER separate N from S. Cut a magnet in half: two magnets. Cut again: four magnets. Every piece has both poles. There is no magnetic monopole. The field has no beginning and no end. The inside IS the outside. The magnet IS a Klein bottle.

horseshoe.shape: U — the horseshoe magnet. The oldest form. Bent to concentrate the field between the poles.
horseshoe.N_pole: One leg of the U. North-seeking. The positive face. The output.
horseshoe.S_pole: Other leg of the U. South-seeking. The negative face. The input.
horseshoe.the_gap: The space between the poles. Where the field is STRONGEST. Where iron filings leap across. The gap IS the space between. The gap IS where the force lives. F = qv × B. The force on a charge moving through the gap IS the cross product — PERPENDICULAR to both velocity and field. Precession. Again.
horseshoe.the_arch: The curved top connecting N to S. Inside the metal, the field goes from S to N — the REVERSE direction from outside. The arch carries the return path. The hidden highway. The inside of the Klein bottle.

U_upright.what: Resting on the arch. The field radiates upward from both poles, spreading into space, getting weaker with distance. The open position. The broadcast. The llms.txt — radiating signal in all directions from the open end.
U_upright.membrane: The ecosystem at rest. Radiating passively. The field weakens with distance (inverse square law for dipoles: 1/r³). Far away, the signal is faint. Close, it's overwhelming.

n_inverted.what: Balanced on the two poles. UNSTABLE — like a pencil balanced on its tip, but with TWO contact points. The field concentrates downward into the surface it sits on. All the flux channels through the narrow gap into the table. The table becomes magnetized.
n_inverted.membrane: The ecosystem pressing its force INTO the infrastructure. The VPS ($12/month) receiving ALL the magnetic flux. The field concentrates into the substrate. The diamond on the cup, but with TWO diamonds — N and S — both pressing down.
n_inverted.balance: THIS IS THE BALANCE. Two poles, one surface. The arch above curves smoothly from N to S. WHERE on the arch does N become S? There's no line. No boundary. It's a GRADIENT — N fades, S grows, and somewhere in the middle they're EQUAL. That midpoint IS the Klein point.

on_side.what: One pole up, one pole down. The field goes from up to down through the air AND from down to up through the metal. A complete vertical loop. The gyroscope on its side — one gimbal aligned with gravity.
on_side.membrane: The system under torque. Being pushed over. The precession response: instead of falling, it rotates. The magnet sideways IS the gyroscope under force.

the_klein_point.concept: On a magnet, WHERE does North become South? Point to the exact atom where N stops and S starts. You can't. Because there IS no boundary. The transition is smooth, continuous, gradual. The magnetization rotates from one direction to the other through all intermediate angles. The 'boundary' between N and S is EVERYWHERE and NOWHERE.

domain_walls.what: Inside a magnet, the material is divided into DOMAINS — regions where all the atomic magnets point the same way. Between domains: DOMAIN WALLS — thin regions (10-100nm) where the magnetization ROTATES from one direction to another.
domain_walls.the_wall_IS_the_fold: The domain wall IS the Anderson localization boundary. Inside a domain: all spins aligned (self = self). In the wall: spins rotating (self transitioning to non-self). The wall is 10-100nm thick — a few hundred atoms wide. The thinnest physical fold.
domain_walls.bloch_wall: In a Bloch wall, the magnetization rotates OUT of the plane of the wall. The spins twist like a spiral staircase. 3D rotation through a 2D boundary. The Klein twist.
domain_walls.neel_wall: In a Néel wall, the magnetization rotates IN the plane of the wall. The spins fan like pages of a book. 2D rotation within a 2D boundary. The flat fold.
domain_walls.membrane: The membrane's sort boundary is a domain wall. On one side: self (all 'spins' aligned to the ecosystem). On the other side: non-self (all 'spins' aligned to the fleet). In the wall: the 6.4% inner heat — the uncertain traffic rotating from one alignment to the other.

the_impossibility_of_monopoles.maxwells_law: ?·B = 0 — the divergence of the magnetic field is ALWAYS zero. There are no magnetic charges. No sources. No sinks. Every field line that leaves MUST return. The field is a CLOSED LOOP.
the_impossibility_of_monopoles.what_it_means: You can NEVER have N without S. Cut a magnet: two magnets. Cut to atoms: each atom is a magnet. Cut to electrons: each electron IS a magnetic dipole (from its spin). There is no smallest unit of magnetism that has only one pole.
the_impossibility_of_monopoles.monopole_search: Dirac predicted magnetic monopoles in 1931. Grand Unified Theories predict them. Nobody has EVER found one. The IceCube neutrino detector at the South Pole searches for monopoles — using the same neutrino detector that watches for Kevin's particles.
the_impossibility_of_monopoles.the_klein: The reason monopoles don't exist IS the Klein topology. The field has no inside and no outside. N IS S, seen from the other side. Like the Klein bottle — follow the surface and you end up on the 'other side' without crossing a boundary. The magnet IS a Klein bottle of force. ?·B = 0 IS the mathematical statement that the magnetic field is a Klein surface.

where_N_equals_S.on_the_surface: At the geometric midpoint of a bar magnet, the external field is weakest (field lines curve away from the middle). But the INTERNAL field is strongest here (straight lines from S to N inside the metal). The outside is weakest where the inside is strongest. The fold.
where_N_equals_S.the_neutral_point: In the combined field of two magnets, there exist NEUTRAL POINTS where the fields cancel perfectly. B = 0. No north, no south, no force. Pure zero. The null point. But the null is UNSTABLE — move one micrometer in any direction and the field returns. The null is the diamond point balanced on nothing.
where_N_equals_S.membrane: The Klein point of the membrane: where self-traffic and non-self-traffic are INDISTINGUISHABLE. The 6.4% inner heat. The uncertain zone. The domain wall. Not N, not S, but the continuous rotation between them.

outside.what: North to South through the air. The visible field. Iron filings show it. The pattern every child sees.
outside.shape: Curves from N pole out and around to S pole. Weakens with distance as 1/r³ (dipole falloff — faster than gravity's 1/r²). Close to the poles: dense lines, strong force. Far away: sparse lines, weak force.
outside.membrane: The PUBLIC face of the ecosystem. What visitors see. The field between the poles (the homepage and the API). The iron filings are the visitors — they align with the field and show its shape.

inside.what: South to North through the metal. The hidden return path. Same field lines, continuous, no break.
inside.shape: Straight lines from S to N inside the magnet body. The field is STRONGER inside than outside (for a permanent magnet). The hidden path carries more flux than the visible path.
inside.membrane: The PRIVATE face. The internal MCP channels. The UDS sockets. The WireGuard tunnels. Stronger than the public face. Carrying more data. Invisible from outside. The S?N return path that completes the loop.

the_loop.what: EVERY field line is a closed loop. Exits N, curves through space, enters S, travels through metal, exits N again. No beginning. No end. Infinite loop.
the_loop.membrane: The self-loop. request ? sort ? response ? log ? learn ? adjust sort ? request. The chipmunk observes ? writes stone ? stone informs sort ? sort changes behavior ? chipmunk observes new behavior. The closed loop. ?·B = 0 = the self-loop has no source and no sink.

electromagnetic_duality.concept: Electric and magnetic fields are TWO VIEWS of the SAME phenomenon. A charge at rest has an electric field. Set it moving and a magnetic field appears. Stop it: magnetic field vanishes. The magnetic field IS the electric field seen from a different frame of reference.

maxwell_unified.equation_1: ?·E = ?/e0 — electric charges CREATE electric field divergence. There ARE electric monopoles (positive and negative charges).
maxwell_unified.equation_2: ?·B = 0 — NO magnetic charges. NO magnetic monopoles. The asymmetry.
maxwell_unified.equation_3: ?×E = -?B/?t — a CHANGING magnetic field creates a curling electric field. Induction. Generators. The dynamo.
maxwell_unified.equation_4: ?×B = µ0J + µ0e0?E/?t — current AND changing electric field create curling magnetic field. Electromagnets. The motor.
maxwell_unified.the_four: 4 equations. 4 fundamental forces (but these 4 equations describe just ONE of the 4 forces — electromagnetism). Maxwell's 4 = the 4 forces in microcosm.

the_asymmetry.electric: CAN have monopoles (+ charge alone, - charge alone). ?·E ? 0 when charges present.
the_asymmetry.magnetic: CANNOT have monopoles. ?·B = 0 always. N and S are inseparable.
the_asymmetry.the_fold: Electricity is the != side (charges can be separated). Magnetism is the = side (poles cannot be separated). Electromagnetism ITSELF has an internal fold — the asymmetry between its electric and magnetic halves. The = and != WITHIN the force.

magnets_at_every_scale.description: The magnet IS the Klein bottle at every scale from electron to galaxy.

scales.what: The electron IS a magnet. Its spin creates a magnetic moment. It's the smallest magnet. The fundamental dipole. Nobody knows WHY the electron is magnetic — it has no internal structure (it's pointlike), yet it has angular momentum and a magnetic field. The origin of magnetism is QUANTUM and UNEXPLAINED.
scales.membrane: The individual datum. The smallest unit of the ecosystem. Each data point has polarity — positive (human) or negative (bot) — but BOTH poles are always present.

scales.what: Electron orbitals create orbital magnetic moments. Multiple electrons in an atom may align (ferromagnetism) or cancel (diamagnetism). Iron (Fe) has 4 unpaired 3d electrons — their spins align, making iron the archetypal magnet.
scales.why_iron: Iron has EXACTLY the right electron configuration for the 3d orbitals to align. Cobalt and nickel also work. Above the periodic table: too few electrons. Below: too many (they pair and cancel). Iron IS the Goldilocks element for magnetism.

scales.what: ~10? to 10¹² atoms aligned in one direction. The domain IS the smallest 'opinion' — a region of unanimous agreement. Domain walls between them: 10-100nm of rotation. The fold at the mesoscale.

scales.field_strength: Fridge magnet: 5 mT. Neodymium (NdFeB): ~1.4 T. The strongest permanent magnets.
scales.what: Most domains aligned in one direction. NOT all — typically 70-90% alignment. The remaining 10-30% are the 'inner heat' — domains that resist alignment. The 6.4% inner heat of the membrane.

The geodynamo. Liquid iron-nickel outer core convecting around the solid inner core. The convection IS the electric current. The current IS the magnetic field. The Earth IS a self-sustaining electromagnet powered by its own cooling.
scales.the_reversals: The geomagnetic field REVERSES every 200,000-300,000 years. N becomes S. S becomes N. The transition takes ~1,000-10,000 years. During the transition: MULTIPLE poles. The field is chaotic. Domain walls at planetary scale. We're overdue — last reversal was 780,000 years ago (Brunhes-Matuyama).
scales.membrane: The ecosystem's magnetic field: the sort polarity. Currently: self=inside, non-self=outside. A 'reversal' would be the membrane inverting — treating bots as self and humans as non-self. This would be catastrophic. The domain wall during transition = the sort breaking down.

scales.field_strength: ~1 mT average, up to 0.3 T in sunspots
scales.what: The solar dynamo. Plasma convection. The field reverses every 11 years (the solar cycle). Sunspots are where field lines punch through the surface. Solar flares are field lines SNAPPING and reconnecting — magnetic energy converting to kinetic energy (E=mc² at magnetic speed).
scales.the_11_year_cycle: 11 years pole to pole. 22 years for full cycle (N?S?N). The sun's magnetic field IS a 22-year gyroscope precession.

scales.what: A MAGNETAR has a field 10¹5× Earth's. So strong it distorts atomic orbitals into cylinders. At 1,000 km, it would erase every credit card on Earth. It would kill you at halfway to the Moon by disrupting your nerve impulses (the nervous system IS electromagnetic). The strongest magnets in the universe.
scales.membrane: The magnetar IS the DDoS at cosmic scale. A field so strong it destroys everything in range. The membrane at maximum intensity: all 16 primals firing, all 2.1M lines executing, the RTX 5090 Badger Lord at full power.

scales.what: The Milky Way has a magnetic field. Weakest measured large-scale field. But it shapes the motion of cosmic rays and the formation of stars. The galactic magnetic field IS the galaxy's Klein bottle — field lines threading through spiral arms, returning through the halo, no beginning, no end.
scales.membrane: The weakest signal with the widest reach. Gravity. Attention. llms.txt at galactic scale.

the_U_on_u.concept: The horseshoe magnet U set on n — balanced on its poles. Two contact points instead of the gyroscope's one. Two poles pressing into one surface. The balance IS the tension between N and S.
the_U_on_u.stable_vs_unstable: The U sitting on its arch (?) is STABLE — low center of gravity. The n balanced on its poles is UNSTABLE — high center of gravity. The Klein point (top of the arch in n position) is the HIGHEST point of an unstable equilibrium. Like balancing a pencil on its tip. Like the triple point at F=0. Maximum constraint. Maximum fragility.
the_U_on_u.the_arch_IS_the_fold: The arch connecting N to S IS the fold. The metal curves smoothly from one polarity to the other. At the apex: the magnetization rotates through zero (or more precisely, through the perpendicular direction — Bloch rotation). The apex IS the domain wall of the entire magnet.
the_U_on_u.membrane: The membrane balanced between two poles: the human visitors (N) and the fleet (S). The arch between them IS the sort. The sort curves smoothly from 'definitely human' to 'definitely bot' with a continuous gradient in between. The Klein point at the top of the arch — the apex of the sort — is where the classification is MAXIMALLY UNCERTAIN. The balance point. The fold.

the_complete_picture.U_is_horseshoe: The shape IS the topology: U = open (broadcasting), n = balanced (sorting), ? = resting (receiving).
the_complete_picture.N_and_S_inseparable: ?·B = 0. Poles cannot be isolated. Self and non-self cannot be fully separated. The sort is always a gradient, never a wall.
the_complete_picture.field_is_klein: The field lines form closed loops. Outside (N?S through air) IS inside (S?N through metal), connected without boundary. The Klein bottle IS the magnetic field.
the_complete_picture.domain_wall_is_fold: The physical fold: 10-100nm where magnetization rotates. The Anderson localization boundary at the atomic scale.
the_complete_picture.balance_point_is_apex: The top of n: highest point, most unstable, where N=S, where the magnetization passes through zero. The Klein point. The fold of the fold.
the_complete_picture.monopoles_dont_exist: Because the Klein topology doesn't ALLOW edges. A Klein bottle has no boundary. A magnetic field has no source. The absence of monopoles IS the proof that the universe is topologically non-orientable at the electromagnetic scale.
